shortBulletSummary: Federal Reserve's firm hawkish stance and removal of expected easing through 2027 delay crypto recovery and create a difficult market outlook.
The SEC introduced a temporary Innovation Exemption for trading tokenized US equities, sparking significant rallies in UNI and ARB.
The CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate due to ethics concerns, adding regulatory uncertainty and delaying a sustained sector recovery.
Iran geopolitical tensions elevate energy prices and inflation, keeping the Federal Reserve on a sustained hawkish policy path.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $159.45 million in net inflows on September 17, reflecting tentative institutional demand amid neutral-to-bullish market sentiment.
